pr_title: Hide empty columns on new mod select design
pr_body:
Closes #18154.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20418176/167300827-ac083d43-c168-483e-a458-828939686c65.mp4

This immediately exposes more issues, most of which are mentioned [in this discord conversation](https://discord.com/channels/188630481301012481/188630652340404224/972854220292251678), but I'm PRing at least for discussion/so that it can be tweaked with further.

As for the code itself, the most annoying part was preserving the pop in/out animations wherein columns fly in from alternate directions. I have managed to salvage it, but I'm not sure if the end result is legible.
pr_comments: Haven't deeply checked that, but I'm wondering if the pop in/out changes could be simplified using `columnsFlow.Where(c => !c.Column.AllFiltered.Value)` instead?

That logic was written in a very particular way to avoid issues with scenarios such as:

* Set filter once
* Hide overlay
* Set filter again
* Show overlay

The issue you want to avoid is that for instance, if a column didn't pop out at the hide (so it didn't move off the screen), but then pops in and already is at the correct Y position, it wouldn't end up moving in at all. Always applying transitions, but doing so instantaneously on filtered and with duration on non-filtered columns avoids this.
As I've mentioned in discord, from a UX perspective I'm not sure I agree with this. But let's push this out and see what users say, if anything.
